This game is simply PEAK. I cant help but apreciate all the love and soul that was clearly poured into every single mechanic in this game! Absolutely worth every dollar and MORE. Go play it NOW. I aint requesting.

Amazing and cozy game with a good artstyle and ost. can recommend also needs a bigger community. The dev also listens to feedback from the community. This game also has a lot of really nice little details such as the gellis being able to run into eachother 10/10 (note: pls add the hamburger duck)

Absolute masterpiece. I was grinning ear to ear the entire time I played, as the game is truly whimsical. And yes, it did indeed help me relax in the real world. True advertising. 11/10 stars. I recommend.

Very simple and fun! There's always something to do and it never stops being engaging. I would say it lacks a bit of polish in some aspects, (I thought the tutorial books were a bit boring, and I think the text looks a little odd sometimes) but it's very charming and I would recommend it to anybody who likes cozy games. It seems like the game is going to be consistently updated, so my complaints may not even be relevant in the future! 8/10
If you love collecting things in games, want to turn your brain off and get sucked into a world of wonder filled with silly slimes this game is great for that!

This game is genuinely one of the best games I have played, it's cozy, fun and just super easy to get into! You can tell that a lot of care has been put into this, from the artstyle, gameplay to even the little secrets hidden around. It is fun to collect everything and see what this world has to offer. I think it is also great that the dev listens to the community. Now stop reading the reviews and go play the game!

Not usually into zone out/relaxing type games, but this one is a really good one. Even only having played a little bit it's clear already that there's a lot to see and do even as of the time of writing this review, which is only a few days after the game launched, and it's even more clear there's plans for a lot of support in the future. Art style and music is very lovely as well! Solid 9/10 game overall!

IT'S JUST SO PEAK i loved seeing this game's development and i'm so happy for it to finally be real! it was a little buggy at the start but the patches released fixed all the issues i had, and the game itself is great!

Gelli Fields is another one of those cozy games you end up getting sucked into for hours. I've played the demo many times and am thrilled the game has been released. The Gelli Fields team put together a game that reminds you of all the other cozy games but still remains unique! Even watching others play gives you that warm and relaxed vibe. Fairlii from Wonder Pond is an amazing developer that I always look forward to hearing something new from him. I know he has more instore for this game, I can't wait for when updates come out! I recommend Gelli Fields to anyone and everyone - give it a try!

I don’t often write reviews even though I play a lot of games, but this one is truly special! First of all, the controller support is really good on it, and it works amazingly on the steam deck! That’s really important to me because playing with a controller is much more comfortable for my health. There is so much passion put into this game that I can feel every time I play it! It’s so fun and full of charm and life, and it just makes me feel happy and smile even when I have a lot of pain. I never knew about this game at all until YouTube recommended it to me, but I really hope other people get a chance to see it and play it, because it is really fun. I love the incremental gameplay loop, and it’s perfect for winding down before bed or calming down from stress. Also, the dev is absolutely top notch, I joined the discord today to report a bug I had come across, and within 20 minutes he had a patch out for it! They were also so kind and genuine, it was amazing! Please, give this game a chance if it at all looks like something you’re interested in, and I hope you’ll enjoy it just as much as I am!!
Generally has a lot to improve on but regardless, it is still relatively a great game.
cute and fun little game to turn your brain off to :)

Its a bit difficult to play on Ultra-Wide-Screens because you have to click very precisely to plant anything. I kept misclickicking and it only worked for me when I hovered the seeds from below the earth and lightly threw them upwards onto the plot. Anyhow I LOVED this game so far. Its a cute collection game where you feed slimes with different tastes and designs. I also liked how the developer clearly thought about how each biome can feel different. I can recommend it to anyone who values creative ideas in game design and cozy clicker games.

Very cute lil game, made by a cool and responsive indie dev. Very exciting to see how it further develops with biomes and such.

GELLI FIELDS!!!! I was very excited to see that the content was released early, I played the Demo after finding the Dev on TikTok and having some very genuine and nice conversation. I LOVED this game, very cozy, the gameplay is unique compared to other cozy games but had a similar feel, but I do like how each level is a little bit different so its not just the same mechanic over and over again. I love their little names, and that they each have personalities and likes and dislikes. Definite replayability factor and recommend everyone buys it! I can't wait to see what else they add to the game in the future. PLAY GELLI FIELDS!!

Simply can't wait for more! I just finished everything the game has to offer so far, and it was time very well spent. The game is incredibly calming, cozy, and absolutely adorable. The humor lands perfectly, and the characters are extremely lovable! I also loved the soundtrack, it reminded me of Stardew Valley and Minecraft, which made exploring the world even more enjoyable There are plenty of similar games out there, but this one just hits differently. The developers have done an amazing job. I completely fell in love with the art style, music, gameplay, and characters. I'm so happy the game is still in development because I can't wait to see what comes next! Ps. extra love for the gelli names (Gloopert is my absolute favourite)
